notes:
Context: OpalScout is a European SaaS vendor providing an in-app knowledge assistant for mid-market support teams. Currently using hybrid vector index (managed Pinecone) + OpenAI embeddings; looking for single-vendor hosted inference + vectors to simplify ops.

Highlights from discovery call (Jordan P + Maya S):
- Indexing scale: target 1.5-2.5M passages initially (docs + auto-split paragraphs), expect steady growth ~25%/yr.
- QPS / load: high QPS patterns from peak weekday support: 400-900 qps for search endpoints (avg 300 qps off-peak). Need predictable tail latency at scale.
- Flow: client search -> ANN candidate set (~top 200) -> lightweight embed-based score + cross-encoder rerank top 30-50. Rerank must be fast (p95 goal <120ms ideally, hard cap 200ms).
- Cost sensitivity: unit cost per query must be modeled (embedding + ANN lookup + rerank). Finance asked for model comparing hosted APi vs current Pinecone+OpenAI.
- Model preferences: open weights desirable (cost), but willing to pay for Redwood hosted if latency and SLOs guaranteed. Interested in quantized variants for rerank and a cheaper retrieval model for first-pass.
- Security / compliance: EU data residency is mandatory for primary index; SOC2 or equivalent required. SSO/SAML for admin console. Audit logs retention 1 year.
- Deployment: prefer Redwood hosted API (no infra ops), but want Private/VPC evaluation if needed for residency.

Customer quote paraphrase: "We need the same-day latency guarantees during weekday peaks — if you can't hit p95 at scale we can't migrate. Also, finance will not accept a >2x increase in per-query cost vs current baseline without measurable quality gains."

POC ask (from OpalScout):
- 30-day POC to index 250k canonical KB pages (subset) + simulate peak QPS (load tests at 1x/2x expected peak).
- Measure p50/p95/p99 for retrieval and full rerank path.
- Provide cost estimate for steady-state at 1.5M passages and at peak QPS of 900.
- Show fallback policy to lower-cost model when capacity constrained.
